Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Secure a rope route in ten minutes. Give your group 1 Boon to traverse it and climb the rope at normal movement cost.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes securing the route.
Target / range / shape
One natural climb or gap and a suitable rope.
Equipment / acquisition
One ordinary rope coil (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Movement / Utility

Establish a suitable rope route between anchors you can actually reach and secure. You and up to six companions gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls traversing it. Climbing along that secured rope costs 1 movement per square. The benefits last while the route and rope remain intact.
